verdict.rationale: Supabase provides a dedicated AI toolkit for Postgres+pgvector, explicitly documenting vector embeddings storage and similarity search as a core feature, plus a homepage callout of 'Vector embeddings' as a first-class product capability, backed by a case study (Berri AI) of real-world usage. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of vector search performance/scale and deeper docs excerpts on index types or query syntax.
